title: DUEL CHANNEL: HONEYDEW LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN
lines: 01 DUEL CHANNEL: HONEYDEW LIMITED-TIME EVENT OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can earn [Grand Duel Fireworks] by participating in event stages and completing daily activities, and level up the [Honeydew Program] to receive corresponding event rewards.
REWARDS: Event Furniture, Event Icon, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, and more.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Theme H5-1 or H9-1 or H15-1

DETAILS: The permanent game mode [Holographic Combat Matrix] will be available. Stages in this mode include various additional Criteria that players can freely choose; meet the specified conditions to earn themed background and event plaque rewards.
Please stay tuned for more information!
